@sketch
Feature: Arc center point

  @acceptance @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: arc-center-point-01 Commit the intended result
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an editable planar sketch is active
    When the user select Center Point Arc, choose its center, start point, and end direction
    Then an arc is created from the selected center, start and end direction
    And the command requests another center
    When the user press Escape
    Then the arc remains and the sketch returns to Ready

  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: arc-center-point-06 Cancel after selecting the center
    Given the observed sketch fixture is Ready
    When the user choose Center Point Arc and select a center
    Then the prompt requests the start point
    When the user press Escape
    Then the MCAD Software returns to Ready without a new arc

  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: arc-center-point-07 Cancel after center and start
    Given the observed sketch fixture is Ready
    When the user invoke Center Point Arc
    And the user select a center and a start point
    Then the prompt requests the end point
    When the user press Escape
    Then the MCAD Software returns to Ready without a new arc

  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: arc-center-point-08 Create and undo and redo a center-point arc
    Given the captured 1700 by 1012 sketch view is Ready with the recorded starting sketch state
    When the user invoke Center Point Arc
    And the user click the captured center at window coordinate (1530, 600), the start at (1570, 600), and the end direction at (1530, 640)
    Then the short arc appears below and right of the center
    And the command requests another center
    When the user press Escape
    Then the arc remains
    When the user undo
    Then the arc disappears
    When the user redo
    Then the arc returns

  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: arc-center-point-09 Measure the restored curve instead of its middle point
    Given the pointer-created arc made with center (1530, 600), start (1570, 600), and end direction (1530, 640) in the captured window coordinates has been restored by Redo
    When the user open Measure and select its middle point
    Then the selection type is Middle Point
    When the user clear the selection and select the curve near its start
    Then the selection type is Curve
    And the radius is 4.759 mm and diameter is 9.518 mm
    And the length is 7.037 mm
    
  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: arc-center-point-10 Reject the same requested center and start position
    Given Center Point Arc requests its start point after center selection
    When the user click the same requested center position
    Then the prompt remains Select start point with radius zero
    When the user press 4 in this captured state
    Then command alias input appears instead of an edited radius
    When the user press Escape
    Then the command exits without committing a new arc

  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: arc-center-point-11 Create a numeric radius and sweep
    Given a fresh Center Point Arc command with a selected center
    When the user enter 4 for radius
    And the user press Tab
    Then the radius is locked at 4 mm and focus moves to the start-angle field
    When the user click the recorded start location
    Then the command requests the end point
    When the user press 9 and then 0 for the sweep
    And the user press Tab
    Then the sweep is locked at 90 degrees
    When the user click the recorded endpoint location
    Then the command requests another center
    When the user press Escape and measure the arc
    Then Measure reports radius 4.000 mm and sweep 90.00 degrees
    And its center is (0, 4.914, 17.623) mm
    And the resulting arc is oriented toward the upper right

  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: arc-center-point-12 Cancel a proposed radius edit
    Given the radius dimension editor is open with 4 mm selected
    When the user replace its expression with 5 and press Escape
    And the user reopen the radius annotation
    Then the editor still contains 4 mm

  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: arc-center-point-13 Accept and undo a radius edit
    Given the created arc has radius 4 mm and sweep 90 degrees
    And its measured center is (0, 4.914, 17.623) mm
    When the user open the radius dimension and change it to 5 mm
    And the user exit dimension editing and measure the arc
    Then Measure reports radius 5.000 mm, length 7.854 mm and the same center
    When the user close Measure and undo
    Then the displayed radius returns to 4 mm
    When the user redo
    Then the displayed radius returns to 5 mm

  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: arc-center-point-14 Accept and undo a sweep edit
    Given the recorded arc has radius 5 mm, sweep 90 degrees and center (0, 4.914, 17.623) mm
    When the user open the sweep dimension
    And the user press 1, then 2, then 0
    And the user accept the edit, exit dimension editing and measure the arc
    Then Measure reports sweep 120 degrees, length 10.472 mm and radius 5 mm
    And its center remains (0, 4.914, 17.623) mm
    And the arc extends toward the upper left in the recorded view
    When the user close Measure and undo
    Then the displayed sweep returns to 90 degrees
    When the user redo
    Then the displayed sweep returns to 120 degrees

steps.step: an editable planar sketch is active
the user select Center Point Arc, choose its center, start point, and end direction
an arc is created from the selected center, start and end direction
the arc remains and the sketch returns to Ready
